howToPlay: Use Ollie's high mobility and hypnosis effects to control enemy movement during combat. Coordinate the use of the Kick Push star power near walls to reposition quickly or use the Renegade star power to gain a shield while dashing into the fray.
gears: Equip HEALTH to maintain survivability during aggressive plays and DAMAGE to increase impact after taking hits. SHIELD provides extra protection while engaging enemies at close range.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy tactical disruption and calculated crowd control in close quarters.
